question: Is poor SemanticKITTI performance a broken supervision/training pipeline or a model that learns KITTI-360 but does not generalise?
supervision: approved raw-LiDAR targets under /media/SSD1/MINH_DATASETS/lingbot_gate8c1/targets (occupied endpoints, free ray interiors, unobserved and conflicting voxels ignored); SSCBench _1_1.npy labels are never read

conditions.mapper_dilate: Chebyshev dilation of mapper by 2 voxels = 0.4 m

mapper_definition_deviation: The target-domain audit used q["occupied"] & (sem_w > 0), where occupied also drops MoGe-only voxels with fewer than 2 MoGe confirmations. The cached source samples do not store n_lb/n_moge, so that term cannot be reproduced here and is omitted.
masks: gt_valid from the raw-LiDAR target; applied only when counting
boundary: centre distance to any face <0.4 m
interior: centre distance to every face >=2 m
precision: float32 inputs; CUDA bfloat16 autocast; float32 final logits

phase2.selection: per drive, np.linspace over the sorted sample list; shares 6/5/5 across drives 0003/0007/0010; recorded before any training
phase2.init: torch.manual_seed(0), random.seed(0), np.random.seed(0), then CompletionUNet(width=24, padding_mode="zeros")
phase2.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 0.01, CosineAnnealingLR over 2000 steps, grad clip 1.0, batch 4, crop 128x128x32, sampler uniform, loss focal_dice + 0.5 semantic KL (configs/gate8c1/seed0.yaml)
phase2.checkpoint_selection: none; the step-2000 head is used

fit_criterion.occupancy_loss_initial: mean of the masked occupancy loss over steps 1-10
fit_criterion.occupancy_loss_final: mean of the masked occupancy loss over steps 1991-2000
fit_criterion.pooled_training_sc_iou: pooled over the 16 full 256x256x32 training clips at tau=-0.125, valid voxels only

known_limitation: frozen_manifest code_hashes list gate8/net.py 4cbfced7...; the recovered source is 56852e4a... The audit established the difference is optional padding variants defaulting to zeros, and this checkpoint carries no padding_mode key, so zero padding is selected.
